# Closed covariant result context

This independently owned fixture exercises a public static result-only Object
formal beside an opaque `Class<? extends Annotation>` context, a fixed receiver
and an original varargs array. The closed declared runtime exceptions remain
unchanged. No input determines the result identity.

The frozen observer runs five call routes and sixteen modes, twice per fresh
JVM. It checks actual arbitrary and null results, original caller casts, null
contexts, array identity and partial failures, callback snapshots and late
writes, ignored calls and exact exception identity. Fourteen independent wrong
programs must fail before recovery. Source and dependency profiles compile all
emitted Java at release 8 and compare complete class/method metadata, roles and
Exceptions. Eight Signature-only controls preserve Code and runtime descriptors.
